instruction: Please configure VS Code to enable format on save, so my code is automatically formatted according to the project's style rules whenever I save a file.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to modify VS Code settings.json to enable format on save. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify the setting is enabled.
metadata.verification: The check_json_settings function verifies that settings.json contains 'editor.formatOnSave': true. No new functions needed.
